A newly created **Fighter** starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches (x2)** — item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23 respectively.

**Defined in:** `worker/src/services/character.ts`, in `createCharacter()` (starting gear logic around lines 59 and 65), per the class/item table in `docs/flows/character-creation.md`. Item IDs are seeded in `worker/src/db/seed.ts`. Note: item `23` is labeled "Torches" in-game though code comments call it "Rations" (documented bug B-09).
